issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, deskripsi berkas, kategori "Baba Yaga - Russian fairy tales", dipakai di bcl.wikipedia.org: Baba Yaga. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: Variations of the name Baba Yaga are found in many Slavic languages, where baba means grandmother or old woman.
claims.statement_id: Variasi nama Baba Yaga ditemukan dalam banyak bahasa Slavia, di mana baba berarti nenek atau wanita tua.
claims.quote: Variations of the name Baba Yaga are found in many Slavic languages. In Serbian, Croatian, Macedonian, Romanian and Bulgarian, baba means 'grandmother' or 'old woman'.

claims.statement: In the 19th century, Alexander Afanasyev proposed the derivation of Proto-Slavic and Sanskrit ahi (serpent).
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-19, Alexander Afanasyev mengusulkan penurunan nama Yaga dari Proto-Slavia dan Sanskerta ahi (ular).
claims.quote: In the 19th century, Alexander Afanasyev proposed the derivation of Proto-Slavic *ož and Sanskrit ahi ('serpent'). This etymology has been explored by 20th-century scholars.

claims.statement: Ježibaba is a figure closely related to Baba Yaga occurring in West Slavic folklore, particularly Czech and Slovak traditions.
claims.statement_id: Ježibaba adalah sosok yang berkerabat dekat dengan Baba Yaga dalam cerita rakyat Slavia Barat, khususnya tradisi Ceko dan Slowakia.
claims.quote: Ježibaba (see cs:Ježibaba), a figure closely related to Baba Yaga, occurs in the folklore of the West Slavic peoples.

claims.statement: Baba Roga is a South Slavic folklore figure used to scare children in Bosnia, Croatia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Serbia.
claims.statement_id: Baba Roga adalah sosok folklor Slavia Selatan yang digunakan untuk menakut-nakuti anak-anak di Bosnia, Kroasia, Montenegro, Makedonia Utara, dan Serbia.
claims.quote: Baba Roga (used to scare children in Bosnia, Croatia, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Serbia), šumska majka ('Forest Mother'), and the babice; and the Slovenian jaga baba or ježibaba

claims.statement: The earliest clear written mention of Baba Yaga appears in 1755 in Mikhail V. Lomonosov Russian Grammar.
claims.statement_id: Penyebutan tertulis Baba Yaga yang paling awal muncul pada tahun 1755 dalam Tata Bahasa Rusia karya Mikhail V. Lomonosov.
claims.quote: occurs in 1755 in Mikhail V. Lomonosov's Russian Grammar [ru]. In Lomonosov's grammar book, Baba Yaga is mentioned twice among other figures largely from Slavic tradition.

claims.statement: The hut on chicken legs deep in the forest resembles stilt huts on tree stumps used by Finno-Ugric peoples.
claims.statement_id: Gubuk di atas kaki ayam di hutan menyerupai lumbung panggung di atas tunggul pohon yang digunakan masyarakat Finno-Ugrik.
claims.quote: The "hut on chicken legs deep in the forest" plainly resembles huts raised on one or several stilts using stump with roots for the stilts, in popular use by Finno-Ugric peoples

claims.statement: Modest Mussorgsky 1874 suite Pictures at an Exhibition contains the movement The Hut on Hen Legs, adapted in 1971 by rock band Emerson, Lake & Palmer.
claims.statement_id: Suite tahun 1874 karya Modest Mussorgsky berjudul Pictures at an Exhibition memuat gerakan The Hut on Hen Legs yang diadaptasi pada tahun 1971 oleh grup rock Emerson, Lake & Palmer.
claims.quote: Mussorgsky's 1874 suite Pictures at an Exhibition has a movement titled "The Hut on Hen's Legs (Baba Yaga)". The rock adaptation of this piece recorded by the English progressive rock band Emerson, Lake & Palmer includes a two-part track

claims.statement: Among Czechs, Poles, and Slovaks, Baba Yaga is spelled as Jezibaba.
claims.statement_id: Bagi masyarakat Ceko, Polandia, dan Slowakia, Baba Yaga dieja dengan Jezibaba.
claims.quote: Bagi masyarakat Ceko, Polandia dan Slowakia, Baba Yaga dieja dengan Jezibaba.

claims.statement: Baba Yaga is a witch or ogress from Slavic folklore who lives in a magical hut in the forest and either helps, imprisons, or eats people.
claims.statement_id: Baba Yaga adalah penyihir atau raksasa perempuan dari folklor Slavia yang tinggal di gubuk ajaib di hutan dan membantu atau memangsa manusia.
claims.quote: Baba Yaga (Baba Jaga) is a witch or ogress from Slavic folklore who lives in a magical hut in the forest and either helps, imprisons, or eats people (usually children).

claims.statement: Baba Yaga hut is built on four tall chicken legs that can turn about or relocate on command, with her large nose touching the ceiling.
claims.statement_id: Gubuk Baba Yaga berdiri di atas empat kaki ayam tinggi yang dapat berputar atau berpindah tempat sesuai perintah, dengan hidung besarnya menyentuh langit-langit.
claims.quote: built on four tall chicken legs that can turn about or relocate on command. She is often seen draped over her stove or reclining in the hut across the entire expanse, with her large nose touching the ceiling.

claims.statement: Baba Yaga rides in a mortar propelled by a pestle with one hand while holding a broom in the other to wipe away traces of her tracks.
claims.statement_id: Baba Yaga terbang mengendarai lesung kayu yang didorong alu dengan satu tangan, sementara tangan lainnya memegang sapu untuk menghapus jejaknya.
claims.quote: she rides in a mortar propelled by a pestle with one hand while, in the other, she holds a broom she uses to wipe away any trace of her tracks. Baba Yaga can generally be understood to mean "Grandmother Witch"

claims.statement: Her hut is surrounded by a wall of human bones topped with skulls, with hinges of foot bones and locks of jawbones with sharp teeth.
claims.statement_id: Gubuknya dikelilingi pagar tulang manusia dengan tengkorak berjejer, gerbang berengsel tulang kaki, dan kunci dari tulang rahang bergigi tajam.
claims.quote: wall of human bones topped with skulls. The gate in the wall had hinges made from the bones of human feet and locks of jawbones set with sharp teeth.

claims.statement: Baba Yaga is viewed as guardian of the fountains of the waters of life and an embodiment of female empowerment and independence.
claims.statement_id: Baba Yaga dipandang sebagai penjaga mata air kehidupan dan perwujudan kemandirian perempuan.
claims.quote: She is among the most famous figures from Slavic folklore as guardian of the fountains of the waters of life and is sometimes seen as embodying female empowerment and independence.

claims.statement: In The Frog Princess, Baba Yaga and her sisters play a pivotal role helping Prince Ivan reunite with his runaway princess.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Putri Katak, Baba Yaga dan saudari-saudarinya memainkan peran penting membantu Pangeran Ivan bersatu kembali dengan putri yang melarikan diri.
claims.quote: In The Frog Princess, Baba Yaga and her sisters play the pivotal role of helping Prince Ivan reunite with his runaway princess after he has betrayed her trust

claims.statement: According to folklore, Baba Yaga is a supernatural crone living deep in the Russian forest in a house on chicken feet surrounded by pine trees and glowing skulls.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita rakyat, Baba Yaga adalah perempuan tua supernatural yang tinggal jauh di dalam hutan Rusia di rumah berkaki ayam yang dikelilingi pohon pinus dan tengkorak bercahaya.
claims.quote: According to folklore, Baba Yaga is a supernatural crone who lives deep in the Russian forest, in a house perched on chicken feet and surrounded by pine trees and glowing skulls.

claims.statement: Tales of her exploits vary, typically either aiding young visitors who stumble upon her hut or attempting to eat them.
claims.statement_id: Kisah-kisah mengenainya bervariasi; ia bisa membantu pengunjung muda yang tersesat di gubuknya atau mencoba memakan mereka.
claims.quote: Tales of her exploits vary, but typically she either aids young visitors who stumble upon her hut in their journeys, or she cuts things short by attempting to eat them.

claims.statement: In the tale of Vasilisa the Beautiful, the most famous story of Baba Yaga, she takes on several seemingly conflicting roles.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Vasilisa si Cantik, cerita paling terkenal tentang Baba Yaga, sosok ini mengambil beberapa peran yang tampak bertentangan.
claims.quote: In the tale of Vasilisa the Beautiful, arguably the most famous story in which Baba Yaga appears, Baba Yaga takes on several, seemingly conflicting roles.

claims.statement: Baba Yaga forces Vasilisa to perform seemingly impossible menial tasks, such as separating rice from wheat before dawn.
claims.statement_id: Baba Yaga memaksa Vasilisa melakukan serangkaian tugas mustahil, seperti memisahkan butir beras dari biji gandum sebelum fajar.
claims.quote: Baba Yaga forces her to do a series of seemingly impossible menial tasks, such as separating grains of rice from wheat kernels before dawn.

claims.statement: When Vasilisa succeeds, she is granted a skull lantern that engulfs her cruel stepfamily in flames upon returning home.
claims.statement_id: Ketika Vasilisa berhasil, ia diberi salah satu lentera tengkorak yang kemudian membakar habis keluarga tiri jahatnya saat tiba di rumah.
claims.quote: When Vasilisa succeeds at this, she’s granted one of the skull lanterns that rings Baba’s house; upon returning home, the lantern immediately engulfs her horrible family in flames

claims.statement: Baba acts as trickster, villain, and savior, ultimately helping Vasilisa rid herself of her stepfamily through violent means.
claims.statement_id: Baba Yaga bertindak sebagai penipu, penjahat, sekaligus penyelamat yang membebaskan Vasilisa dari tirani keluarga tirinya.
claims.quote: Here, Baba acts as trickster, villain, and savior, ultimately helping Vasilisa to rid her of her stepfamily, albeit through shockingly violent and roundabout means.

claims.statement: Protruding from a wooden mortar, the old crone squats with thin downcast lips and dark eyes.
claims.statement_id: Bermunculan dari lesung kayu, wanita tua ini berjongkok dengan bibir tipis terkatup dan mata gelap.
claims.quote: Protruding from the top of a wooden mortar, the old crone squats, her thin lips as downcast as her dark eyes.

claims.statement: Etymologically, Banaspati stems from Sanskrit vanaspati, describing a fire-bodied spirit in Indonesian folklore.
claims.statement_id: Secara etimologi, istilah Banaspati berakar dari bahasa Sanskerta vanaspati sebagai makhluk halus berwujud api di Indonesia.
claims.quote: Sanskerta: वनस्पति, alih aksara: vanaspati ) merupakan salah satu sosok dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat di Indonesia yang digambarkan sebagai makhluk halus berwujud api.

claims.statement: In folk tradition, Banaspati is known as a ghost or spirit with the primary element of fire in Java and Kalimantan.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi masyarakat, Banaspati dikenal sebagai hantu atau roh berelemen api di Pulau Jawa dan Kalimantan.
claims.quote: Dalam tradisi masyarakat, Banaspati dikenal sebagai hantu atau roh dengan elemen utama api, yang dipercaya muncul dalam berbagai wujud dan nama di sejumlah daerah, khususnya di Pulau Jawa dan Kalimantan.

claims.statement: Banaspati is depicted in two main forms: a floating fireball or a burning human walking with inverted feet facing upward.
claims.statement_id: Banaspati digambarkan dalam dua wujud utama: bola api yang melayang atau manusia terbakar yang berjalan dengan kaki menghadap ke atas.
claims.quote: Banaspati sering digambarkan dalam dua wujud utama yaitu sebagai bola api yang melayang atau pusaran api, serta sebagai manusia terbakar yang berjalan dengan posisi terbalik, yaitu kaki menghadap ke atas.

claims.statement: Banaspati geni merges with air, deriving strength from human fear to empower its fiery energy.
claims.statement_id: Banaspati geni bersenyawa dengan udara dan kekuatannya diperkuat oleh rasa takut manusia.
claims.quote: Banaspati geni bersenyawa dengan udara dan mengandalkan elemen api. Udara dianggap sebagai sumber kekuatannya, sedangkan rasa takut dari manusia menjadi bahan untuk memperkuat energi api.

claims.statement: Reliefs resembling Banaspati stand over temple entrances as guardian symbols repelling negative influences.
claims.statement_id: Relief serupa Banaspati terletak di ambang pintu masuk candi sebagai simbol penjaga penolak pengaruh negatif.
claims.quote: Relief ini umumnya terletak di ambang pintu masuk ruang suci candi, berfungsi sebagai simbol penjaga yang dipercaya dapat menangkis pengaruh negatif atau roh jahat.

claims.statement: Banaspati tanah liat inhabits forests draining blood or energy, with footwear wearers being more vulnerable.
claims.statement_id: Banaspati tanah liat mendiami hutan untuk mengisap darah atau energi, dengan korban bersepatu lebih rentan.
claims.quote: Banaspati tanah liat biasanya ditemukan di hutan dan diyakini berburu mangsa dengan cara mengisap energi atau darah korban. Masyarakat percaya bahwa orang yang tidak menyentuh tanah secara langsung, misalnya menggunakan alas kaki, lebih rentan menjadi target.

claims.statement: Standing barefoot on the earth is considered a safe way to avoid Banaspati tanah liat attacks.
claims.statement_id: Berdiri di atas tanah tanpa alas kaki dianggap sebagai cara aman menghindari serangan Banaspati tanah liat.
claims.quote: Oleh karena itu, berdiri di atas tanah tanpa alas kaki dianggap cara aman untuk menghindari serangan Banaspati tanah liat.

claims.statement: Banaspati banyu biru can merge with water so its fire does not extinguish in wet environments.
claims.statement_id: Banaspati banyu biru memiliki kemampuan menyatu dengan air sehingga apinya tidak padam di lingkungan basah.
claims.quote: Banaspati banyu biru diyakini memiliki kemampuan untuk menyatu dengan air, sehingga apinya tidak padam meski berada di lingkungan basah.

claims.statement: Banaspati is linked to Kirthimukha in Indian mythology, a guardian giant head born from Shiva wrath.
claims.statement_id: Banaspati dikaitkan dengan Kirthimukha dalam mitologi India, kepala raksasa pelindung yang lahir dari kemarahan Dewa Siwa.
claims.quote: Beberapa sumber mengaitkan Banaspati dengan mitologi India, khususnya sosok Kirthimukha, kepala raksasa yang muncul dalam arsitektur candi. Menurut literatur, Kirthimukha lahir dari kemarahan Dewa Siwa untuk menaklukkan makhluk jahat Rahu.

claims.statement: In Javanese tradition, Banaspati is described as a floating fireball or a burning inverted humanoid.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Jawa, Banaspati digambarkan sebagai bola api melayang atau manusia terbakar berkaki terbalik.
claims.quote: Dalam tradisi Jawa, banaspati digambarkan sebagai makhluk mistis berbentuk bola api yang bisa melayang atau sosok manusia terbakar dengan posisi terbalik, di mana kakinya menghadap ke atas.

claims.statement: This entity is often associated with evil forces, curses, or santet sent to harm individuals.
claims.statement_id: Sosok ini sering dikaitkan dengan kekuatan jahat, teluh, atau santet untuk mencelakai seseorang.
claims.quote: Sosok ini sering dikaitkan dengan kekuatan jahat, teluh, atau santet yang dikirim untuk mencelakai seseorang.

claims.statement: People believe Banaspati serves as a forest guardian floating between trees.
claims.statement_id: Masyarakat meyakini Banaspati sebagai penjaga hutan yang melayang di antara pepohonan.
claims.quote: Kemudian, ada kepercayaan masyarakat yang menyebut banaspati sebagai penjaga hutan. Banaspati diyakini muncul di antara pepohonan dan melayang dari satu titik ke titik lain.

claims.statement: Banaspati imagery is found on Javanese temple doorway reliefs as protective symbols repelling evil spirits.
claims.statement_id: Bentuk Banaspati ditemukan pada relief ambang pintu candi Jawa sebagai simbol pelindung pengusir roh jahat.
claims.quote: Bentuk banaspati juga ditemukan dalam relief candi-candi di Jawa, terutama di bagian ambang pintu masuk. Ukiran tersebut berfungsi sebagai simbol pelindung yang dipercaya dapat mengusir roh jahat

claims.statement: The fireball is initially fist-sized but can enlarge when its victim feels fear.
claims.statement_id: Bola api ini awalnya sebesar genggaman tangan tetapi dapat membesar saat korbannya merasa ketakutan.
claims.quote: Ukuran bola api ini dikirakan sebesar genggaman tangan orang dewasa, namun bisa membesar ketika korbannya ketakutan.

claims.statement: In burning human form, it walks on its hands with feet facing up, protruding flame tongues to consume prey.
claims.statement_id: Dalam wujud manusia terbakar, ia berjalan dengan tangan dan kaki menghadap atas sambil menjulurkan lidah api.
claims.quote: Sementara dalam wujud manusia terbakar, banaspati berjalan dengan kedua tangan dan kakinya menghadap atas sambil menjulurkan lidah api untuk memangsa targetnya.

claims.statement: In Javanese society three types of Banaspati are recognized: banaspati geni, banaspati tanah liat, and banaspati air.
claims.statement_id: Dalam masyarakat Jawa dikenal tiga jenis Banaspati: banaspati geni, banaspati tanah liat, dan banaspati air.
claims.quote: Dalam masyarakat Jawa dikenal tiga jenis banaspati, yakni banaspati geni (api), banaspati tanah liat, dan banaspati air.

claims.statement: Scientifically, this fireball phenomenon is called Ignis Fatuus or Will-o-the-Wisp in wetlands and forests.
claims.statement_id: Secara ilmiah, fenomena bola api ini disebut Ignis Fatuus atau Will-o-the-Wisp di daerah lembap dan hutan.
claims.quote: Dalam kajian ilmiah, fenomena tersebut disebut “Ignis Fatuus” atau “Will-o’-the-Wisp”, yakni cahaya alami yang biasa muncul di daerah lembap seperti rawa-rawa, hutan, hingga area pemakaman.

claims.statement: The light originates from methane and phosphine gases produced by decaying organic matter.
claims.statement_id: Cahaya tersebut dihasilkan dari pembakaran gas metana dan fosfin hasil pembusukan bahan organik.
claims.quote: Cahaya tersebut berasal dari adanya gas metana (CH4) dan fosfin (PH3) yang dihasilkan dari proses pembusukan bahan organik di alam, seperti tumbuhan atau hewan yang telah mati.

claims.statement: Banaspati ornamentation is placed above doorway arches of Javanese temples such as Mendut, Borobudur, Prambanan, and Singosari.
claims.statement_id: Hiasan Banaspati terpasang di ambang pintu candi Hindu-Buddha Jawa seperti Candi Mendut, Borobudur, Prambanan, dan Singosari.
claims.quote: Hantu Banaspati termasuk cerita rakyat di Pulau Jawa dan Kalimantan. Banaspati diwujudkan dalam bentuk hiasan patung yang terpasang di ambang pintu candi. Bisa ditemui di berbagai candi Jawa Indonesia Hindu, seperti candi Mendut, Borobudur, Prambanan, dan Singosari.

claims.statement: Banaspati appears as a fierce giant face, a floating fireball, or a burning human.
claims.statement_id: Wujud Banaspati berupa raksasa berwajah seram, bola api melayang, atau manusia terbakar.
claims.quote: Bentuk dari Banaspati merupakan raksasa berwajah seram, beberapa sumber menyebutkan bentuknya seperti bola api yang melayang atau manusia yang terbakar.

claims.statement: People believe Banaspati is a fire-associated jin that manifests to disturb humans in Java.
claims.statement_id: Masyarakat meyakini Banaspati sebagai jin berelemen api yang mengganggu manusia di Pulau Jawa.
claims.quote: Makhluk mistis yang identik dengan api dan berasal dari daerah di Pulau Jawa. Kebanyakan masyarakat meyakini bahwa banaspati merupakan jin yang menampakkan diri untuk mengganggu manusia.

claims.statement: Sorcerers use Banaspati for santet, and it is known by names such as Kala, Boma, Barong, Gupala, or Butakala.
claims.statement_id: Dukun menggunakan Banaspati untuk santet, dan sosok ini memiliki nama seperti Kala, Boma, Barong, Gupala, atau Butakala.
claims.quote: Konon, para dukun menggunakan Banaspati untuk melakukan santet. Banaspati memiliki banyak nama berbeda di setiap daerah. Ada yang menyebutnya sebagai Kala, Boma, Barong, Gupala, Butakala, Kedok/Topeng, Batara Kala

issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, deskripsi berkas, kategori "Banshee (mythology)", dipakai di ast.wikipedia.org: Banshee. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: A banshee is a female spirit in Irish folklore who heralds the death of a family member.
claims.statement_id: Banshee adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia yang menandai kematian anggota keluarga.
claims.quote: A banshee (/ˈbænʃiː/ BAN-shee; Modern Irish bean sí  [bʲanˠ ˈʃiː] , from Old Irish: ben síde  [bʲen ˈʃiːðʲe] , "woman of the fairy mound" or "fairy woman") is a female spirit in Irish folklore who heralds the death of a family member

claims.statement: Her name connects to ancient mounds across Ireland known as side in Old Irish.
claims.statement_id: Nama banshee terhubung dengan gundukan kuno di pedesaan Irlandia yang dikenal sebagai side dalam bahasa Irlandia Kuno.
claims.quote: Her name is connected to the mythologically important tumuli or "mounds" that dot the Irish countryside, which are known as síde  (singular síd ) in Old Irish.

claims.statement: She is sometimes seen with long streaming hair that she combs.
claims.statement_id: Banshee kadang terlihat memiliki rambut panjang terurai yang sedang disisir.
claims.quote: Sometimes she has long streaming hair, which she may be seen combing, with some legends specifying she can only keen while combing her hair.

claims.statement: She wears a grey cloak over a green dress with red eyes from weeping.
claims.statement_id: Banshee digambarkan mengenakan jubah abu-abu di atas gaun hijau dengan mata merah karena terus menangis.
claims.quote: She wears a grey cloak over a green dress, and her eyes are red from continual weeping.

claims.statement: An account by Ann Lady Fanshawe describes a figure in white with red hair and ghastly complexion.
claims.statement_id: Kesaksian Ann Lady Fanshawe mencatat sosok berpakaian putih dengan rambut merah dan rona wajah pucat.
claims.quote: She may be dressed in white with red hair and a ghastly complexion, according to a firsthand account by Ann, Lady Fanshawe in her Memoirs.

claims.statement: In Ireland and Scotland, mourning traditionally includes keening women who wail laments.
claims.statement_id: Di Irlandia dan Skotlandia, bagian tradisi perkabungan mencakup perempuan peratap yang melantunkan duka.
claims.quote: In Ireland and parts of Scotland, a traditional part of mourning is the keening woman (bean chaointe ), who wails a lament

claims.statement: The keening woman was sometimes a professional in high demand.
claims.statement_id: Perempuan peratap kadang kala merupakan tenaga profesional yang sangat diminati.
claims.quote: This keening woman may in some cases be a professional, and the best keeners would be in high demand.

claims.statement: Multiple banshees appearing together signifies the demise of someone great or holy.
claims.statement_id: Kemunculan beberapa banshee sekaligus menandai wafatnya orang suci atau tokoh agung.
claims.quote: When several banshees appear at once, it indicates the death of someone great or holy. The tales sometimes recounted that the woman, though called a fairy, was a ghost, often of a specific murdered woman, or a mother who died in childbirth.

claims.statement: In parts of Leinster, she is called a keening woman whose wail can shatter glass.
claims.statement_id: Di beberapa wilayah Leinster, banshee disebut perempuan peratap yang jeritannya dapat memecahkan kaca.
claims.quote: In some parts of Leinster, she is referred to as the bean chaointe  ('keening woman') whose wail can be so piercing that it shatters glass.

claims.statement: The banshee is a fairy from Irish folklore whose scream warns of someone's passing.
claims.statement_id: Banshee merupakan peri dari cerita rakyat Irlandia yang jeritannya menjadi pertanda ajal seseorang di dekatnya.
claims.quote: The Banshee is a fairy from old Irish folklore. It is said that if you hear a Banshee’s scream, it is a warning that someone close to you is on the verge of passing.

claims.statement: The banshee is known for a spine-tingling scream sounding like a wailing woman.
claims.statement_id: Banshee dikenal dengan jeritan mengerikan yang terdengar seperti perempuan meratap dalam kesedihan mendalam.
claims.quote: The Banshee is known for its spine-tingling scream. You will hear many different accounts from across Ireland about the true sound, but the Banshee is said to sound like a woman wailing in a distressed manner.

claims.statement: The legend of the banshee is believed to stem from the grieving tradition of keening.
claims.statement_id: Legenda banshee diyakini berakar dari tradisi meratap atau keening yang merupakan luapan rasa berduka.
claims.quote: Many believe that the legend of the Banshee originated from the tradition of ‘Keening‘, which is a passionate expression of grief.

claims.statement: The word keen comes from Gaelic caoineadh meaning to weep in Irish funeral rituals.
claims.statement_id: Kata keen berasal dari bahasa Gaelik caoineadh yang berarti menangis atau meratap dalam ritual pemakaman.
claims.quote: The word ‘Keen’ comes from the Gaelic word ‘caoineadh’, which means to cry or weep and it used to be an Irish funeral ritual.

claims.statement: The key difference is that banshees predict someone's death beforehand.
claims.statement_id: Perbedaan pokok banshee dengan pelayat manusia adalah banshee meramalkan kematian sebelum terjadi.
claims.quote: the main difference between Banshees and Keening women is that the Banshees can predict the passing of someone, which is why they spark fear in many.

claims.statement: Her scream is said to foretell the passing of someone close to the listener.
claims.statement_id: Jeritan banshee diyakini menubuatkan meninggalnya seseorang yang dekat dengan pendengar jeritan tersebut.
claims.quote: It is said that the Banshee’s scream foretells the passing of someone close to the one who hears her scream.

claims.statement: Many people mistake the banshee cry for the sound of an animal like a fox.
claims.statement_id: Banyak orang mengira jeritan banshee bersumber dari suara satwa malam seperti rubah.
claims.quote: While strongly liked to the traditional of ‘Keening’, it is likely that many mistake the Banshee scream with the sound of an animal, like a fox.

claims.statement: Richard de Clare encountered a wizened old woman washing bloodstained clothes in a swift river.
claims.statement_id: Pasukan Richard de Clare menjumpai perempuan tua keriput yang mencuci pakaian dan zirah bernoda darah di sungai.
claims.quote: came upon a grim and wizened old woman washing armour and fine robes, all stained with blood, in the swift running river.

claims.statement: The figure was said to make her home in the misted mounds of the fairies.
claims.statement_id: Sosok tersebut digambarkan mendiami bukit gundukan peri berkabut.
claims.quote: she was the woman of the waters of misery, who made her home in the misted mounds of the fairies - but she was of the tribes of hell

claims.statement: The hag was seen washing limbs and clothes until waters were defiled with blood.
claims.statement_id: Sosok perempuan tua meratap mencuci sisa-sisa bagian tubuh berdarah di aliran air.
claims.quote: The hag was washing human limbs and heads with gory weapons and clothes, till all the waters were defiled with blood, brains, and floating hair.

claims.statement: The banshee has been known to follow families abroad to other countries.
claims.statement_id: Banshee dikenal membuntuti garis keturunan keluarga tertentu bahkan hingga ke mancanegara.
claims.quote: she has been known to follow families abroad and dog their footsteps in other countries.

claims.statement: She rose on the wind yelling words of woe until vanishing.
claims.statement_id: Sosok ini dapat membubung tinggi di atas angin sambil berteriak kata-kata duka hingga menghilang.
claims.quote: The angry men raised their javelins, but she rose on the wind, yelling more and more words of woe till she vanished.

claims.statement: Barong or Barongan is a figure in Javanese culture and Balinese mythology.
claims.statement_id: Barong atau Barongan merupakan figur dalam kebudayaan Jawa dan mitologi Bali.
claims.quote: Barongan atau Barong, adalah figur dalam kebudayaan Jawa dan mitologi Bali .

claims.statement: Barong is portrayed in animal disguises, most famously with a lion head.
claims.statement_id: Barong digambarkan menyerupai samaran binatang dengan figur paling terkenal berkepala singa.
claims.quote: Penampilannya digambarkan dalam berbagai bentuk samaran seperti binatang, dan yang paling terkenal dan dipuja dari semuanya adalah figur makhluk berkaki empat atau berkaki dua dengan kepala singa.

claims.statement: As leader of virtue, Barong battles the demon queen Rangda.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai pemimpin kebajikan, Barong bertempur melawan ratu iblis Rangda.
claims.quote: Sebagai pemimpin pasukan kebaikan, ia bertempur melawan ratu iblis, Rangda.

claims.statement: This mythological narrative is the basis of ritual dance in Bali and Java.
claims.statement_id: Alur cerita mitologi Barong menjadi dasar tarian ritual populer di Bali dan Jawa.
claims.quote: Alur cerita mitologis ini merupakan dasar dari tarian kostum ritual, yang sangat populer di kalangan orang Bali dan para penduduk di beberapa daerah Jawa.

claims.statement: The confrontation between Barongan and Rangda is a major storyline in local mythology.
claims.statement_id: Konfrontasi Barongan dan Rangda merupakan alur cerita utama dalam epik mitologi lokal.
claims.quote: Konfrontasi antara Barongan dan Rangda adalah salah satu alur cerita utama dalam sebuah epik mitologi lokal

claims.statement: Barong is frequently depicted with a lion head as king of the forest.
claims.statement_id: Barong lebih sering digambarkan berkepala singa sebagai raja hutan.
claims.quote: lebih sering digambarkan dengan kepala singa, yang dalam berbagai mitos digambarkan sebagai "raja hutan".

claims.statement: The Barong mask features a lion snout with thick mane and beard.
claims.statement_id: Topeng Barong memiliki moncong singa dengan surai lebat dan jenggot.
claims.quote: topeng ini memiliki moncong berupa singa dengan surai tebal dan jenggot, tetapi beberapa daerah menggunakan hewan yang berbeda)

claims.statement: Barong and Rangda represent traditional Balinese performance art.
claims.statement_id: Barong dan Rangda merupakan seni pertunjukan tradisional Bali.
claims.quote: Barong dan rangda merupakan salah satu seni pertunjukan tradisional Bali.

claims.statement: The most common form staged alongside Rangda is Barong Ket.
claims.statement_id: Jenis Barong yang paling umum dipentaskan bersama Rangda adalah Barong Ket.
claims.quote: mulai barong bangkung, barong macan, barong brutuk, barong landing, dan lainnya. Tetapi, yang paling umum dan biasanya dipentaskan bersamaan rangda adalah barong ket.

claims.statement: Barong and Rangda were originally sacred art forms in Bali.
claims.statement_id: Barong dan Rangda awalnya merupakan wujud kesenian yang disakralkan masyarakat Bali.
claims.quote: Barong dan rangda awalnya adalah dua wujud kesenian yang disakralkan oleh orang Bali.

claims.statement: Barong represents good forces (dharma) while Rangda represents evil (adharma).
claims.statement_id: Barong diidentikkan dengan kekuatan baik dharma sedangkan Rangda dengan kekuatan jahat adharma.
claims.quote: barong diidentikkan sebagai kekuatan baik (dharma), sedangkan rangda diidentikkan dengan kekuatan jahat (adharma).

claims.statement: In Calonarang drama, Barong appears to confront Rangda wrath.
claims.statement_id: Dalam dramatari Calonarang, Barong muncul melawan kemurkaan Rangda.
claims.quote: Dalam pertunjukan dramatari Calonarang, barong biasanya muncul melawan kemurkaan Rangda.

claims.statement: Lion-formed Barong is considered a guardian spirit king embodying virtue.
claims.statement_id: Barong berwujud singa dianggap sebagai raja roh pelindung yang mewakili kebajikan.
claims.quote: Dalam mitologi Bali, Barong adalah salah satu tokoh berwujud singa. Tokoh tersebut dianggap sebagai raja roh yang mewakili kebajikan, yang dikenal sebagai malaikat pelindung.

claims.statement: Barong Ket blends attributes of lion, tiger, dragon, and cow.
claims.statement_id: Barong Ket merupakan perpaduan bentuk singa, macan, naga, dan sapi.
claims.quote: Barong Ket merupakan perpaduan antara singa, macan, naga, dan sapi.

claims.statement: Barong dance is sacred and revered on par with Hindu deities.
claims.statement_id: Tari Barong merupakan tarian sakral dengan posisi terhormat setara kekuasaan dewa Hindu.
claims.quote: Bagi masyarakat Bali, tari Barong merupakan tari sakral yang mempunyai posisi tinggi dan setara dengan kekuasan dewa Hindu.

claims.statement: Upon Barong appearance, entranced dancers turn keris inwards until revived by holy water.
claims.statement_id: Saat Barong hadir, penari menusukkan keris ke tubuh sendiri lalu disadarkan kembali dengan air suci.
claims.quote:
Saat Barong muncul, mereka mengubah arah kerisnya dan menusukkan ke diri sendiri. 
 Pemain kesurupan dan terlahir kembali setelah diberi percikan air suci.

claims.statement: Sacred ritual Barong performances differ from tourist entertainment.
claims.statement_id: Pementasan Barong sakral untuk upacara adat berbeda dengan pertunjukan hiburan wisata.
claims.quote: Tari Barong yang digunakan untuk adat serta sakral, pementasannya berbeda dengan pertunjukkan hiburan atau wisata.

claims.statement: The Barong tale symbolizes an eternal clash between good and evil.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Barong melambangkan pertarungan abadi antara kebaikan dan keburukan.
claims.quote: Ceritanya merupakan pertempuran abadi antara kebaikan dan keburukan yang diiringi musik tradisional.

images.description: This elaborate Barong is kept in a pavilion in the inner courtyard of Pura Taman Ayun, the royal temple of the Mengwi dynasty.

claims.statement: Fenrir or Fenrisulfr is a monstrous wolf in Norse mythology also known as the monster of the river Van in Norway and Iceland.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir atau Fenrisulfr merupakan monster serigala raksasa dalam mitologi Nordik yang juga dijuluki monster sungai Van di Norwegia dan Islandia.
claims.quote: Fenrir (Old Norse 'fen-dweller') or Fenrisúlfr (Old Norse "Fenrir's wolf", often translated "Fenris-wolf"), also referred to as Hróðvitnir (Old Norse "fame-wolf") and Vánagandr (Old Norse 'monster of the [River] Ván'), is a monstrous wolf in Norse mythology.

claims.statement: Fenrir alongside Hel and Jormungandr is a child of Loki and giantess Angrboda.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir bersama Hel dan Jormungandr adalah anak dari dewa Loki dan raksasa wanita Angrboda.
claims.quote: Fenrir, along with Hel and Jörmungandr, is a child of Loki and female jötunn Angrboða.

claims.statement: Fenrir is foretold to kill the god Odin during Ragnarok before being killed by Vidarr.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir diramalkan membunuh dewa Odin saat Ragnarok sebelum dibunuh oleh anak Odin bernama Vidarr.
claims.quote: foretold to kill the god Odin during the events of Ragnarök, but will in turn be killed by Odin's son Víðarr.

claims.statement: The dwarves constructed Gleipnir from six mythical ingredients as soft as a silk ribbon.
claims.statement_id: Para kurcaci membuat rantai Gleipnir dari enam bahan mitos hingga sehalus pita sutra.
claims.quote: The dwarves constructed Gleipnir from six mythical ingredients. After an exchange between Gangleri and High, High continues that the fetter was smooth and soft as a silken ribbon

claims.statement: Fenrir saliva formed the river Van where he lies bound until Ragnarok.
claims.statement_id: Air liur Fenrir mengalir deras membentuk sungai Van tempat ia terbelenggu hingga hari Ragnarok.
claims.quote: and this saliva formed the river Ván (Old Norse "hope"). There Fenrir will lie until Ragnarök.

claims.statement: Tyr placed his hand within the wolf's mouth as a pledge.
claims.statement_id: Dewa Tyr meletakkan tangannya ke dalam mulut sang serigala sebagai jaminan janji.
claims.quote: Týr placed his hand within the wolf's mouth as a pledge.

claims.statement: Fenrir is the great wolf in Norse mythology who breaks free at Ragnarok and kills Odin.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir adalah serigala besar mitologi Nordik yang memutus belenggu saat Ragnarok dan menewaskan Odin.
claims.quote: Fenrir is the great wolf in Norse Mythology who breaks free from his chains at Ragnarök, the twilight of the gods, kills Odin, and is then killed by Odin’s son Vidarr.

claims.statement: Fenrir is the son of Loki and brother of serpent Jormungandr and Hel.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir adalah putra dewa muslihat Loki dan saudara dari ular dunia Jormungandr serta Hel.
claims.quote: Fenrir is the son of the trickster god Loki and brother of the World Serpent Jormungandr and the jotunn Hel.

claims.statement: Only the god Tyr was brave enough to feed Fenrir creating a bond between them.
claims.statement_id: Hanya dewa Tyr yang cukup berani memberi makan Fenrir yang menumbuhkan persahabatan di antara keduanya.
claims.quote: only the god Tyr is brave enough to feed him which encourages a friendship between the two.

claims.statement: Dwarves forged Gleipnir from six mythical elements including cat footsteps and woman beard.
claims.statement_id: Kurcaci menciptakan rantai Gleipnir dari enam unsur mustahil seperti jejak kucing dan janggut wanita.
claims.quote: The dwarves send back the chain called Gleipnir (“entangler”) made of six elements: a cat’s footsteps, a woman’s beard, mountain roots, sinews of a bear, the breath of a fish, and the spittle of a bird.

claims.statement: His friend Tyr volunteered placing his hand in the wolf's mouth.
claims.statement_id: Sahabatnya dewa Tyr bersedia menjadi sukarelawan meletakkan tangannya di mulut sang serigala.
claims.quote: his friend Tyr volunteers, placing his hand in the wolf’s mouth.

claims.statement: Realizing he was trapped, he snapped his jaws and bit off Tyr hand.
claims.statement_id: Sadar dirinya terperangkap, sang serigala menutup rahangnya dan menggigit putus tangan Tyr.
claims.quote: Realizing he has been trapped, he snaps his jaws closed, taking Tyr’s hand.

claims.statement: The wolf howled in fury as the gods thrust a great sword into his mouth.
claims.statement_id: Sang serigala melolong marah lalu para dewa memasang pedang besar ke dalam mulutnya.
claims.quote: The wolf begins to howl in pain and rage, but the gods – except for Tyr - only laugh at him and then force a great sword into his mouth

claims.statement: Fenrir is the son of Loki and Angrboda, brother of serpent Jormungand and underworld goddess Hel.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir adalah putra dewa Loki dan raksasa Angrboda, saudara dari ular Jormungand dan penguasa alam baka Hel.
claims.quote: He’s the son of the god Loki and the giantess Angrboda, which makes him the brother of the serpent Jormungand and the underworld goddess Hel.

claims.statement: Fenrir was suspicious of the third fetter and refused without a god hand in his mouth.
claims.statement_id: Fenrir menaruh curiga pada belenggu ketiga dan menolak diikat tanpa ada tangan dewa di mulutnya.
claims.quote: When the gods presented Fenrir with this third fetter, he became suspicious, and he refused to be bound with it unless one of the gods would stick his or her hand in his mouth

claims.statement: Only Tyr was brave enough knowing it would mean losing his hand.
claims.statement_id: Hanya Tyr yang cukup berani melakukannya meski tahu dirinya akan kehilangan tangan.
claims.quote: Only Tyr was brave enough to do this, knowing that it would mean the loss of his hand.

claims.statement: When Fenrir found himself unable to break free, he ripped Tyr hand from his arm.
claims.statement_id: Ketika mendapati dirinya tidak mampu lolos dari ikatan, Fenrir merenggut tangan Tyr dari lengannya.
claims.quote: when Fenrir found himself unable to break free of his bonds, he ripped Tyr’s hand from its arm.

claims.statement: The chain was tied to a boulder and a sword was placed in Fenrir jaws to keep them open.
claims.statement_id: Rantai itu diikatkan ke batu besar dan sebuah pedang dipasang di rahang Fenrir agar tetap menganga.
claims.quote: The chain was then tied to a boulder and a sword was placed in Fenrir’s jaws to hold them open.
